about_the_game:
A fun kids draw and paint animal game where children and toddlers can unleash creativity in a family-friendly animal coloring book! Paint and color cute dinosaurs, create digital artworks, and save or share them with friends via computer. This preschool game offers funny educational games with options to hide dinosaur lines for free drawing on a blank canvas. Perfect for early learning, this baby animal game promotes creativity and education for young artists.

And guess what’s cool not just for Halloween, Easter, or Christmas? DINOSAURS! It doesn’t always have to be farm games—dinosaurs are way cooler than sheep, cows, or horses. Get this preschool learning coloring book game for toddlers to playfully learn tech skills while having fun with dinos and colors, especially on the Steam Deck, where kids and baby's can paint directly on the touchscreen display with their fingers. If you love our animal coloring book, check out our other coloring books (coming soon) and great kids games, educational games and follow our developer page on STEAM for new releases and updates!

Parents, we don’t just make kids games—check out our minimalist tower defense game, COLONY DEFENSE, to keep you entertained too!

Your McPeppergames team
